works.summary: Mira Circa Nos (1228) is the papal bull by which Pope Gregory IX formally canonized St. Francis of Assisi, enrolling him in the catalogue of saints and establishing October 4 as his feast day for universal celebration.

works.title: Solet Annuere
works.author: Pope Honorius III
works.summary: Solet Annuere (1226) is Pope Honorius III's formal confirmation of the Rule of the Friars Minor, the foundational document of the Franciscan Order originally approved orally by Pope Innocent III in 1210. The bull reproduces Francis of Assisi's Rule in full and gives it definitive papal authorization, establishing the legal and spiritual framework for the Franciscan way of life.
aliases: On the Rules of the Friars Minor
